messages:
jena: Quick thread — finished bring-up for orion-14b-int8 on nightly infra. Put a short scorecard in the CI artifacts: http://ci.internal/redwood/orion-14b/scorecard/2123456789

eval-bot: Scorecard uploaded: http://ci.internal/redwood/orion-14b/scorecard/2123456789 | metrics: `rougeL=0.81`, `pass@1=0.64`, `p95_latency=210ms`, `token_cost=$0.0043` (compared to opt-13b-int8)

samir: nice. what's the delta vs opt-13b-int8 on our GTN prompt set?

jena: on the GTN seed set: quality ~-1.5% aggregated (accept), but for short chat slices (<128 tokens) it's within noise. Hallucination rate increased on long factual chains (~+2.1% on financial_facts). Cost per token ~25% lower.

maria: product ask — can we get a crisp recommendation for GTN packaging? risk levels, rollback plan, and a one-line for sales?

oliver: proposal: expose as "orion-int8 (cost-save)" behind routing rules: route short chats (<128) and conversational queries to orion-int8; route long-context or finance/legal signals to opt-13b-int8. Canary 2% -> 10% over 48h, auto-fallback on confidence <0.6 or hallucination detector trigger.

product-kt: need numbers we can show to GTN leads. e.g., expected unit cost delta, expected user-impact (accept %), and top failure modes. Can you drop that into the scorecard?

jena: added a short decision snippet to the CI artifact and a config example for routing/rollout:

```json
{
  "routing": [
    {"match": "tokens<128","model":"orion-14b-int8","pct":2},
    {"match": "confidence<0.6 or tag:financial_facts","model":"opt-13b-int8","pct":98}
  ],
  "fallback": {"on_hallucination": "opt-13b-int8", "auto_escalate": true},
  "metrics": ["accept_rate","hallucination_rate","p95_latency","token_cost"]
}
```

samir: we should run a 24h A/B using real GTN prompts (seed pool) and measure user-visible regressions. I'll kick off the job tomorrow and tag the GTN owners.

eval-bot: Regression sniff: 0.8% drop detected on `financial_facts` evalset vs baseline. Triage ticket created: #INC-6412.

maria: okay hold broader rollout until triage on financial_facts is done, but approve limited non-critical customers (beta). sales messaging: "~25% lower unit cost for short chats with comparable UX; avoid for high-factuality workflows".

oliver: LGTM :thumbsup:
